_provenance.fields: byte-exact from the live GitHub Actions API response; only fields consumed by validateCentralDispatch (plus id/name/status/conclusion/timestamps for context) are retained -- the full response also carries ~20 *_url link templates that are not part of the validated contract.

This run passed central dispatch validation in production while PR #4820 was still open. See ../README.md.
